TW.1–TW.30: all finite tension coefficients from the lowest electric inputs, exact tensor operators, full low-order forcing and eight full solutions.

TD.1–TD.27: the full subtracted temporal equation, two energy estimates, ordinary forcing and four physical-boundary norms.
GD.1–GD.21: full anchored gauge differences, all inverse and spatial derivative terms, and the exact physical connection and curvature receivers.
PD.1–PD.33 including PD.21a and PD.31a: complete potential-wave and divergence-free differences, endpoint data and physical receiver.

FI.1–FI.42: local heat differences, all affine gauge terms, intervening heat energy, nonidentity transition anchor and all original prescribed-S receiving bounds.
UD.1–UD.35 and UD.4a: anchored coefficient transfer, degree-one temporal heat smoothing, full electric-wave input, signed electric datum, heat-boundary cancellation and physical-time increments.
TDI.1–TDI.35: full spatial tension difference, paired electric smoothing, zero-data energy and derivative estimates, all six low-order wave bounds and signed heat-boundary operation.
